decided: When the sign-off setting has a value orbit does not read, the command that checks whether a change waits for a sign-off still prints its one-line answer on its own, and shows the warning about that value separately, so a person running it sees both.
alternatives: Print the warning as a second line of the normal output.
Leave the warning out of the one-line form.
why: The check is meant to answer in one line, and a person running it still needs to see that their value was ignored; the archive asks for the answer in the form meant for programs, which carries the warning, and states it in one line.
detail: BriefCommand.hold in src/commands/brief.ts: console.error for the warning in text mode; --json carries warning.
